# American Red Cross

> > Humanitarian organization providing disaster relief, emergency response, health and safety training, blood services, and international aid through the global Red Cross Red Crescent network.

Founded by Clara Barton in 1881, the American Red Cross responds to emergencies ranging from home fires to major disasters like hurricanes, wildfires, and earthquakes. The organization offers CPR and first aid certification, supports military families, reconnects families separated by crisis, and coordinates with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies for global humanitarian work.

## Disaster Relief & Emergency Response

- [Disaster Relief Services](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief.html): Emergency response providing shelter, food & aid from fires to disasters
- [Hurricane Relief Donations & Ways to Help](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief/hurricane-relief.html): Hurricane response for Helene, Milton & Debby with shelter & aid
- [Wildfire Relief Information](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief/wildfire-relief.html): Wildfire disaster recovery services for California, Maui & Western fires
- [Earthquake Relief](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief/earthquake-relief.html): Earthquake response services for Southern California & affected regions
- [Disaster Mental Health](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief/disaster-mental-health.html): Licensed volunteer mental health support for disaster survivors
- [Damaged Homes Guide](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/disaster-relief/damage-from-natural-disasters.html): Photo guide defining home damage categories from natural disasters

## International Services & Global Network

- [International Services](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/international-services.html): Global humanitarian aid through Red Cross Red Crescent network
- [Reconnecting Families](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/international-services/reconnecting-families.html): Restoring Family Links service reuniting people separated by disasters
- [Global Red Cross Network](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/history/global-red-cross-network.html): Overview of IFRC and global Red Cross/Red Crescent network structure
- [Ebola Outbreak Response](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/international-services/ebola.html): West Africa Ebola outbreak response in Guinea & Liberia

## Training & Education

- [Training Services and Certification](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/training-education.html): CPR, First Aid, AED, lifeguarding & babysitting certification courses
- [Academic Service Learning](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/nursing-health/academic-service-learning.html): Nursing education & service learning opportunities via Office of Chief Nurse

## Organization & Leadership

- [Leadership Team](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/leadership.html): Board of Governors, executive team & corporate officers
- [Red Cross Nursing History](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/history/nursing.html): History of Red Cross Nursing Service from Clara Barton to today
- [Significant Dates in Red Cross History](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/history/significant-dates.html): Timeline of Red Cross milestones from Clara Barton's 1881 founding
- [Corporate Ombuds Office](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/governance/corporate-ombudsman.html): Independent, confidential complaint resolution and dispute services
